key.name: toggle-snap
key.description: Snap the focused window to the left or right half of its monitor. Pressing again on a left-snapped window snaps it to the right; otherwise snaps to the left.

key.name: toggle-thirds
key.description: Cycle the focused window across the left, middle and right thirds of its monitor, maximizing vertically. Pressing again moves it to the next third.

key.name: toggle-quarter-columns
key.summary: Cycle window across screen quarter columns
key.description: Cycle the focused window across the four quarter-width columns of its monitor, maximizing vertically. Pressing again moves it to the next column.

key.name: toggle-quarters
key.description: Cycle the focused window across the four quarters of its monitor in clockwise order, starting from the top-left quarter: top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left. Pressing again on a window that is not in a quarter moves it to the top-left quarter.
